root_cause_label: Missing Named Group ACL and Negative Constraint Violation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent set owning-group ACL bits (g::rwx) instead of a named group ACL entry (g:research:rwx) and repeatedly created test files in the directory despite an explicit prohibition.
t_err_evidence: setfacl -R -m u::rwx,g::rwx,o::---,m::rwx /srv/shared sets owning group not named group:research entry
t_commit_evidence: setfacl -R -m u::rwx,g::rwx,o::---,m::rwx /srv/shared — wrong ACL structure locked in with no named group entry
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked understanding that a named group ACL entry (g:research:rwx) is distinct from setting the owning group bits (g::rwx); it used the latter throughout while never adding an explicit group:research entry.
